title: Ann Widdecombe’s Dartmoor home where she was murdered goes on sale for £900,000, 4 months after death
summary_full: Ann Widdecombe’s Dartmoor home, where the former Conservative MP was murdered in July 2026, has been put on the market for £900,000, just four months after her death. The five-bedroom property, which she purchased for £600,000 in 2008, features a swimming pool, stables and extensive gardens, with its asking price reflecting a 50% increase.
